_comment: Current values (200/450) are a genuine 2x scale off the ORIGINAL 100/225 (the 1.5x that was promised-but-never-applied, compounded with another ~1.33x on top, landing on a clean round number) -- same 2.25x dusk->night ratio preserved.

sewers._comment: Same day/dusk/night shape as before (night a further even step down), vignette nudged 0.45->0.48 (between the old sewers pin and deep_tunnels' 0.55).

inn_upstairs._comment: Reuses the inn's OWN dusk grade verbatim ([0.85,0.72,0.55]) as the permanent pin -- literally 'always looks like the warm end of the day downstairs', a direct, defensible reuse rather than inventing a new palette.

barracks._comment: TIME-INVARIANT (inn_upstairs/sewers precedent): a barracks is staffed day and night, so it reads the same at any phase rather than tracking the outside clock.

runners_guild._comment: TIME-INVARIANT (barracks/inn_upstairs/sewers precedent): couriers keep counter hours day and night (deliveries complete within any waking), so the room reads the same at any phase.

ruin_surface._comment: Vignette between floodplains (0.4) and sewers (0.45) -- exposed but ruined, not oppressive.

garden._comment: The eyes-closed test IS the mood system itself: if the screen never dims and never vignettes on this map, you are in the garden.

deep_tunnels._comment: The Raskghar descent -- the DARKEST pin in the game, time-invariant (below the sewers, no daylight ever reaches it).

riverfarm_village._comment: "harvest light" -- the ONLY map whose day grade tips warm (identity everywhere else is [1,1,1]); deep-blue night per spec sec.1.

witch_hollow._comment: "green shade" -- never reaches identity white even at day (canopy); dusk is the map's home key (firefly-dense per spec); vignette 0.50 > sewers' 0.45 (enclosure without an underground pin).

brothers_parlor._comment: The hero-light-over-the-card-table contrast survives the lift (the table light's own energy was raised 0.9->1.0 in the same fix, mercantile decor entry).

dungeon_approach._comment: Per-prop accent variation (the 4 trap tells' post-reveal warning tints, the statue/rubble dressing) rides the live decor `tint` field (GH#55) on top of this base grade, not a second mood card.

pallass_market._comment: Crystal lamps (steady white #E9EEF2 PointLight2D per-entity) carry the after-dark read; NEVER amber (the standing quarantine check every future screenshot of this map must pass).

sewers_nest._comment: kept in lockstep with the deepened `moods.sewers` field pin (day/dusk [0.24,0.26,0.37], avg .29) so the vermin/nest fights still read as the SAME underground the player just walked through, not a lit-back-up combat pin.
